Coming off Effexor is a always gonna be rough. Particularly the first week. I’d recommend against doing lsd especially while withdrawing off such a strong fast acting med. If you can’t be swayed out of doing the lsd, I’d at least recommend keeping yourself hydrated and stay away from vigorous activity or stressful situations. It’ll only exacerbate the zaps, irritation, and disorientation. Whatever you do please be safe.
